name: Storage Rentals of America
notes: Researched from the public SROA help-center pages (Account Payments & Billing FAQ, Account Management FAQ) and the My Account log-in page (no sign-in). Log-in: Email + Password, Sign In, Forgot Password?, Register (register your units before signing in). Each tenant also gets a monthly invoice alert email with a personal payment link, and Storage Specialists can send a one-time payment link by email or SMS (no public guest-pay form; guest_pay is unsupported because the only no-login route is a personal link). Online: credit or debit card only (no bank), one-time payment, pre-pay or AutoPay from the Make a Payment drop-down next to the unit; AutoPay can also be reviewed under Billing. No partial payments (fullBalanceOnly). Rent is usually due on the 1st (some stores use the anniversary date); email reminders before the due date. Phone payments by card through the office; Storage Specialists 800-457-5678 (Mon-Fri 8-8 ET, Sat-Sun 9-5:30 ET) cannot see stored cards. Move-out: at least 10 days notice; empty the unit. Late fees, admin fee amounts and refund rules are lease-specific and not published.

guest_pay.note: There is no pay-without-login form. Use the personal payment link in your monthly invoice email, or call a Storage Specialist at 800-457-5678 to get a one-time payment link by email or text.

pay_by_phone.note: Call your store office to pay by credit or debit card.

payment_arrangement.note: SROA does not accept partial payments. Talk to your local Property Manager or a Storage Specialist at 800-457-5678 if you need help.

cancel_service.note: To move out, tell SROA at least 10 days ahead (your store or 800-457-5678), then remove everything from the unit.

help.title: Ways to pay your rent
paragraphs: Every month you get an invoice alert email with a personal payment link. You can also sign in to My Account and use the Make a Payment drop-down next to your unit to make a one-time payment, pay ahead or set up AutoPay. Online payments use a credit or debit card and you get an instant confirmation.

You can also pay at your store (cash, cashier's check, money order, debit or any major card) or by calling the office with a card. SROA does not accept partial payments. Most stores have an after-hours drop box; write your full name, unit number and payment date on the envelope.
steps: Open the Make a Payment drop-down next to your unit.
Choose a one-time payment or pre-pay.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: With AutoPay your monthly rent is charged to your credit or debit card automatically at the beginning of each month. Sign in, open the Make a Payment drop-down next to your unit and choose Setup AutoPay. You can see which units are enrolled under Billing, or enroll at your store during office hours.

help.title: When rent is due
paragraphs: Rent is usually due on the first day of each month, although some locations bill on your move-in anniversary date. SROA emails a reminder before your payment is due. Your own due date is shown in My Account.

help.title: Updating your card
paragraphs: Storage Specialists cannot see or change your stored card. Sign in, choose My Account and then Billing to update your card, pre-pay or review AutoPay. If you need help, call 800-457-5678 and a specialist can send you a one-time payment link by email or text.

help.title: Moving out
paragraphs: Let SROA know at least 10 days before you move out. Your account is noted with the expected move-out date and the property may contact you to confirm. To finish, take your lock off, remove everything and sweep the unit clean.
Storage Specialists are available Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET and weekends 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. ET at 800-457-5678.

extra.intent: Using the SROA help center, find out whether SROA accepts partial payments on a storage unit. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: No, SROA does not accept partial payments.
